notes.title: Season 2 of the leaderboards has begun!
notes.content:
[b]Leaderboard reset[/b]
Season 2 of When Ski Lifts Go Wrong leaderboards is underway! We have reset the leaderboards for all campaign levels, giving everyone a fair chance of reaching that number one spot. 

Throughout Early Access and following the full launch, we have been listening to your feedback to improve the level designs and balance. We have also eliminated some exploits that allowed players to achieve unrealistic scores. We do not plan to rebalance the game for the foreseeable future, therefore we have made the decision to reset the leaderboards as of today! 

This will not affect your saves unless it used an addressed exploit, meaning that you can go in and resubmit your best scores and improve on your already awesome constructions.

[b]Community contribution:[/b]
We’re always on the lookout for the best and most creative workshop contributions and replays, and wanted to share with you one that caught our eye:

notes.title: New Update is Live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

[h1]Patch 1.0.74 is now available, please update your game![/h1]

[b]Thanks again[/b] for the bug reports and feedback. We have worked hard to address both and you can see a summary of changes below.

If you have any issues or feedback going forward, please let us know via the forums!

[b]Summary of changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now change the character (skier, biker, etc.) controls in the settings panel
[*] The achievement to perform a flip while seated in the chairlift has been fixed
[*] The strength of building materials had been slightly increased
[*] Gondolas weight has been slightly reduced, and they do not hang as low as before
[*] Fixed a bug where lifts, people and scenery were loading in the wrong location
[*] Addressed an issue that was causing some players to experience jittery skiers giving the appearance of low FPS
[*] Changed the default graphic settings to medium, from very high[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29825757/19b372684494faada6ca84cb80fa238b211369fa.gif[/img]
We hope you're as excited as unnamed-rider-1774832, *ahem* I mean... Jenny,  here

notes.title: Snowmobiles, extra levels and a whole new mountain
notes.content:
[h1]Patch v0b.01.00[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29825757/88eee01457243852defc8878884b223a9e1ca4dd.gif[/img]

[i]Wow! It’s been 7 weeks since the launch of Carried Away into Early Access and it has absolutely flown by![/i] It may have been radio silence from us for the past few weeks, but by-golly we’ve been busy. 

We have been hard at work engineering a fleet of snowmobiles just for you and our explorers have carved out 16 new levels in a new region known as The Jimmylayas.

[i]Keep reading to get a detailed update of all the changes we have made to Carried Away, or dive on into the game to see for yourself![/i]

[h1]Feedback[/h1]
We want to hear from you! Report ideas, bugs, or other suggestions to  [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/carriedaway/]Reddit[/url] or the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/638000/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url]. Or you can come chat with us on [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/carriedaway]Discord[/url]! We’d love to hear your thoughts.

[h1]Snowmobiles[/h1]
We have added snowmobiles to the game based on popular demand from the community. Snowmobiles offer a new and exciting challenge! Find the right combination of driving style and construction to tackle the mountains. Blue, Green, Purple, Yellow, and Orange.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29825757/659e3b29c970db7595b0fc3c4ebddb5549d213b0.png[/img]

[h1]Improved Rope Material[/h1]
[list]
    [*]You can now connect the rope to the environment and no longer need to connect it to a foundation point
    [*]Max rope length has been increased by 50%
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29825757/58bb440ac0f426a607b71725e0bd736e3e6fe3f4.png[/img]

[h1]In Game Gallery[/h1]
You can now save and watch replays directly to the in-game gallery. Filter by level, budget, pass, or fail and learn from the rest of the community. Then vote on your favourite replays!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29825757/924349bac3165d940aedfc77ed0243f209703cb7.png[/img]

[h1]Balance changes to jumps and their supports[/h1]
We have made changes so that jump materials are more suitable and playful for jumps, bridges, and snow mobiles collectively:
[list]
   [*]Jumps weigh less but aren’t as strong
   [*]Supports are weaker
   [*]Force is now averaged over a small period of time to make the jumps and supports more flexible and receptive to impact. This should make high speeds and jumping less likely to break the jumps whilst heavy objects will still have a significant effect on jump materials.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29825757/cc7f9e4a72bf2fe552f6923652e15c3bdcc03de7.gif[/img]

[h1]The Jimmylayas[/h1]
[b]6x Snowmobile levels, 2x Gondola levels, 3x Chairlift levels, 3x Jump levels,1x Drag Lift level, 1x Bridge level[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29825757/6c210b0c3b6927cc8e6f062c8264c43dc53c98bd.png[/img]

Campaign levels have been rearranged to smooth the difficulty curve, so make sure to check back to previous maps and complete all the levels!

[h1]Improved statistics[/h1]
Analyse where the most tense moments were when testing your structures and compare it between runs. Use this information to improve your structures design.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29825757/f6d0535358c1ad628b28e92b85264ad39ce0de90.png[/img]
Easily see how you fared against the rest of the community using the histograms and filter the scoreboards to show only those who succeeded at getting the trophy achievement.

[h1]Other noteworthy changes[/h1]
[list]
   [*]Building near or behind an object such as a tree will now temporarily make the object transparent
   [*]Default camera settings have been improved to give a better view of what's happening
   [*]Changes to terrain generation - smoother and more predictable skiing down mountains and collision with rocks
   [*]Performance improvements when many things break at once
   [*]Improved the instant replay tool allowing you to capture the best moments with less editing
   [*]Jump supports now collide with trees for consistency 
[/list]

Thanks so much for your support! We will continue to add new features and fun to Carried Away. We welcome your feedback, so come and have a chat with us on [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/carriedaway]Discord[/url], [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/carriedaway/]Reddit[/url], or on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/638000/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url].

- Jonny, Will, and Andy

We have been hard at work engineering a fleet of snowmobiles just for you and our explorers have carved out 16 new levels in a new region known as The Jimmylayas.

[i]Keep reading to get a detailed update of all the changes we have made to Carried Away, or dive on into the game to see for yourself![/i]

[h1]Feedback[/h1]
We want to hear from you! Report ideas, bugs, or other suggestions to  [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/carriedaway/]Reddit[/url] or the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/638000/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url]. Or you can come chat with us on [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/carriedaway]Discord[/url]! We’d love to hear your thoughts.

[h1]Snowmobiles[/h1]
We have added snowmobiles to the game based on popular demand from the community. Snowmobiles offer a new and exciting challenge! Find the right combination of driving style and construction to tackle the mountains. Blue, Green, Purple, Yellow, and Orange.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29825757/659e3b29c970db7595b0fc3c4ebddb5549d213b0.png[/img]

[h1]Improved Rope Material[/h1]
[list]
    [*]You can now connect the rope to the environment and no longer need to connect it to a foundation point
    [*]Max rope length has been increased by 50%
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29825757/58bb440ac0f426a607b71725e0bd736e3e6fe3f4.png[/img]

[h1]In Game Gallery[/h1]
You can now save and watch replays directly to the in-game gallery. Filter by level, budget, pass, or fail and learn from the rest of the community. Then vote on your favourite replays!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29825757/924349bac3165d940aedfc77ed0243f209703cb7.png[/img]

[h1]Balance changes to jumps and their supports[/h1]
We have made changes so that jump materials are more suitable and playful for jumps, bridges, and snow mobiles collectively:
[list]
   [*]Jumps weigh less but aren’t as strong
   [*]Supports are weaker
   [*]Force is now averaged over a small period of time to make the jumps and supports more flexible and receptive to impact. This should make high speeds and jumping less likely to break the jumps whilst heavy objects will still have a significant effect on jump materials.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29825757/cc7f9e4a72bf2fe552f6923652e15c3bdcc03de7.gif[/img]

[h1]The Jimmylayas[/h1]
[b]6x Snowmobile levels, 2x Gondola levels, 3x Chairlift levels, 3x Jump levels,1x Drag Lift level, 1x Bridge level[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29825757/6c210b0c3b6927cc8e6f062c8264c43dc53c98bd.png[/img]

Analyse where the most tense moments were when testing your structures and compare it between runs. Use this information to improve your structures design.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29825757/f6d0535358c1ad628b28e92b85264ad39ce0de90.png[/img]

[list]

   [*]Default camera settings have been improved to give a better view of what's happening
   [*]Changes to terrain generation - smoother and more predictable skiing down mountains and collision with rocks
   [*]Performance improvements when many things break at once
   [*]Improved the instant replay tool allowing you to capture the best moments with less editing
   [*]Jump supports now collide with trees for consistency 
[/list]

Thanks so much for your support! We will continue to add new features and fun to Carried Away. We welcome your feedback, so come and have a chat with us on [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/carriedaway]Discord[/url], [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/carriedaway/]Reddit[/url], or on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/638000/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url].

notes.title: Build shaky ski lifts in Early Access physics sim Carried Away
notes.content:
Fans of charming physics simulation games like bridge-construction game Poly Bridge may have something new to wrap their brains (and support cables) around. Carried Away, now in Early Access, is a sim about constructing chair lifts and gondolas to shepherd skiers up to the tops of the slopes. You can even control your little skiers at times to guide them over the jumps you build, and in addition to several goal-driven campaigns there's a sandbox mode where you can design your own mountains and challenges.

Of course, that's all easier said than done.

Construction is, in theory, very simple. Using anchor points, build lift towers with planks, logs, ropes, and supports, and connect the base to the exit point with a lift cable. Then, start the simulation and see if your skiers make it to the top (after which they'll ski back down). There are obstacles like trees that can get in the way, snow-making machines that can blow skiers around in circles, and the structural integrity of your construction, of course, may simply not be up to snuff.

As with other physics-based building sims, half the fun of Carried Away is in failure. When your carefully (or hastily) constructed tower begins to strain and shudder and collapse, spilling your skiers violently to the ground or into trees and rocks, it can be just as satisfying and fun as when you safely and competently lift them to the top. It's also easy to jump back and forth between construction mode and the simulation, so making adjustments, or starting over completely, just takes a second.

There's also a lot of enjoyment when part of your construction comes crashing down and yet you still manage to pass the level. Above, a set of my logs snapped but the ropes and cables both held, and my skiers still managed to exit the lift safely. Sure, it's a mess and probably scared my guests half to death, but they got to the top. Score! 

You will also be called upon to build bridges and jumps, so your skiers can cross gaps and chasms. Once you've done it, you can control your skiers as well, helping them hunch down and then lift off at the appropriate moment to boost their jumps. Again, easier said than done. Below, you can see I haven't quite figured out how to best build jumps, nor guide my skiers across them.

There are currently about 50 levels in Carried Away, and in the 6 to 12 months in Early Access planned, developer Huge Calf Studios plans to add around 50 more, along with features like snowboarders, mountain bikers, and bombs. Bombs? Bombs.

What I've played so far of Carried Away has been an enjoyable time and, as I said, equally fun when succeeding or failing. You'll find it in Early Access on Steam for $9, with a note that when the game is complete, the developer plans to raise the price.

notes.title: Carried Away now building ski lifts in early access
notes.content: Though eventually I couldn’t tell games apart, I did enjoy the recent-ish bridge-building fad. Watching physics-simulated structures collapse because of my own hubris is always great. But what if a bridge went up tiddly up up? You might get Carried Away [official site], a physics-y building game about crafting ski lifts and ramps to haul skiers up and over mountains. And failures would involve a pleasing amount of watching skiers suffer terrible accidents. Carried Away isn’t due to launch in full until summer 2018 but is out now in early access and does already have a level editor. (more…)

notes.title: Not long until release!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

With the release of Carried Away just around the corner, I want to get the [i]snowball[/i] rolling by telling you what you can expect from day one in Early Access, and what we will be working on in the months following release.

With chairlifts, drag lifts, gondolas, bridges and jumps already implemented, there is plenty of variety across the 40+ campaign levels and 3 different mountains! There is an additional tutorial mountain where you can learn the ropes. We estimate that this will provide around 5-8 hours of gameplay for the average lift builder, but plenty more if you’re trying to top every scoreboard! 

[b]But that’s just the beginning[/b], the sandbox will be available on release day, allowing you to create and share your own slopes, ridiculous constructions and audacious replays. Our growing and active [url=https://discord.gg/eAs8FJn]Discord[/url] community is already doing all of this, so there should be plenty of community created content to check out straight away! 

We will be aiming for a content patch every 4- 6 weeks after release, adding another mountain with around 10 to 14 levels each time. To keep things as fresh as the mountain breeze, we will be adding new physics playthings to empower your creativity - timings on these will depend on balance and polish but the goal is one new feature per content patch! Current popular potentials are vehicles, bombs, winches, zip wires and magic carpets.

Let us know if you're excited to see what’s in store for Carried Away, or better still, come and say hi on Discord or Steam forums. [i]The release date will be announced soon, along with some of the yet to be disclosed features that Early Access will bring, stay tuned![/i]

Jonny, Will and Andy
